# API endpoints

<!-- Generated by backend/src/scripts/gen-docs.ts — do not edit by hand; run `npm run docs -w backend`. -->

133 endpoints, base path `/api/v1`. Conventions (envelope, errors, pagination, idempotency, auth): [../API.md](../API.md). Source of truth: [packages/contract/src/endpoints](../../packages/contract/src/endpoints).

Access: `public` needs no token; `authenticated` needs any signed-in user; `platform` needs a platform admin; otherwise the caller must be an active member of the society in the path holding one of the listed permissions. Surface `gate`/`common` endpoints are the only ones a GUARD may call.

## auth

| Id | Method & path | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auth.lookup` | `POST /auth/lookup` | public<br><sub>rate limit: auth</sub> | Decide the next sign-in screen for a mobile number |
| `auth.activate` | `POST /auth/activate` | public<br><sub>rate limit: auth</sub> | First sign-in: create a password for an admin-added number |
| `auth.login` | `POST /auth/login` | public<br><sub>rate limit: auth</sub> | Sign in with mobile and password |
| `auth.verifyTwoFactor` | `POST /auth/2fa/verify` | public<br><sub>rate limit: auth</sub> | Complete an admin sign-in with a TOTP code |
| `auth.refresh` | `POST /auth/refresh` | public<br><sub>rate limit: sensitive</sub> | Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token |
| `auth.logout` | `POST /auth/logout` | authenticated<br><sub>restricted token ok</sub> | End this session |
| `auth.forcedChange` | `POST /auth/forced-change` | authenticated<br><sub>rate limit: sensitive, restricted token ok</sub> | Replace a temporary password; returns a full session |

## members

| Id | Method & path | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `members.list` | `GET /societies/:societyId/members` | `members.manage` | Member register |
| `members.unitOverview` | `GET /societies/:societyId/units/:unitId/overview` | any member<br><sub>surface: common</sub> | Unit 360: owners, occupancy, tenant, family, vehicles, history |
| `members.addMembership` | `POST /societies/:societyId/units/:unitId/memberships` | `members.manage` | Admit an owner, co-owner or associate member |
| `members.ceaseMembership` | `POST /societies/:societyId/memberships/:membershipId/cease` | `members.manage` | End a membership (sets a cessation date; nothing is deleted) |
| `members.setNominees` | `PUT /societies/:societyId/memberships/:membershipId/nominees` | any member | Replace a member's nominees |
| `members.setOccupancy` | `PUT /societies/:societyId/units/:unitId/occupancy` | `members.manage` | Record the unit's occupancy from a date (drives non-occupancy charges) |
| `members.createTenancy` | `POST /societies/:societyId/units/:unitId/tenancies` | any member | Record a tenancy (owner requests go to approval) |
| `members.updateTenancy` | `PATCH /societies/:societyId/tenancies/:tenancyId` | `members.manage` | Edit or extend a tenancy |
| `members.endTenancy` | `POST /societies/:societyId/tenancies/:tenancyId/end` | any member | End a tenancy and suspend the tenant's access |
| `members.addFamily` | `POST /societies/:societyId/units/:unitId/family` | any member<br><sub>surface: resident</sub> | Add a family member (residents' requests go to approval) |
| `members.removeFamily` | `DELETE /societies/:societyId/family/:familyMemberId` | any member<br><sub>surface: resident</sub> | Remove a family member |
| `members.vehicles` | `GET /societies/:societyId/vehicles` | `members.manage` or `gate.operate` or `gate.manage`<br><sub>surface: gate</sub> | Vehicle register; the gate looks plates up here |
| `members.addVehicle` | `POST /societies/:societyId/units/:unitId/vehicles` | any member<br><sub>surface: resident</sub> | Register a vehicle (residents' requests go to approval) |
| `members.removeVehicle` | `DELETE /societies/:societyId/vehicles/:vehicleId` | any member<br><sub>surface: resident</sub> | Remove a vehicle |
| `members.addPet` | `POST /societies/:societyId/units/:unitId/pets` | any member<br><sub>surface: resident</sub> | Register a pet (residents' requests go to approval) |

## billing

| Id | Method & path | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `billing.heads` | `GET /societies/:societyId/charge-heads` | `billing.generate` or `billing.publish` or `society.configure` | Charge heads with their rate history |
| `billing.createHead` | `POST /societies/:societyId/charge-heads` | `billing.generate` or `society.configure` | Add a charge head (category decides the allowed apportionment) |
| `billing.updateHead` | `PATCH /societies/:societyId/charge-heads/:headId` | `billing.generate` or `society.configure` | Rename, re-filter, reorder or retire a head |
| `billing.setRate` | `POST /societies/:societyId/charge-heads/:headId/rates` | `billing.generate` or `society.configure` | Set a rate from a date — never back into a billed period |
| `billing.simulate` | `GET /societies/:societyId/charge-heads/:headId/simulate` | `billing.generate` or `society.configure` | Who would be billed how much for this head |
| `billing.unitCharges` | `GET /societies/:societyId/unit-charges` | `billing.generate` or `society.configure` | Per-unit amounts for manual heads |
| `billing.createUnitCharge` | `POST /societies/:societyId/unit-charges` | `billing.generate` or `society.configure` | Set a per-unit amount for a manual head |
| `billing.runs` | `GET /societies/:societyId/bill-runs` | `billing.generate` or `billing.publish` | Bill runs, newest period first |
| `billing.createRun` | `POST /societies/:societyId/bill-runs` | `billing.generate` | Generate a draft run for a period and preview it |
| `billing.run` | `GET /societies/:societyId/bill-runs/:runId` | `billing.generate` or `billing.publish` | Run preview: totals by head and building, variances, exceptions |
| `billing.recomputeRun` | `POST /societies/:societyId/bill-runs/:runId/recompute` | `billing.generate` | Recalculate a draft after changing rates or units |
| `billing.publishRun` | `POST /societies/:societyId/bill-runs/:runId/publish` | `billing.publish`<br><sub>idempotent</sub> | Publish: number the bills, post the ledger, notify residents |
| `billing.discardRun` | `POST /societies/:societyId/bill-runs/:runId/discard` | `billing.generate` | Throw away a draft run |
| `billing.bills` | `GET /societies/:societyId/bills` | `billing.generate` or `billing.publish` or `payments.record` or `accounts.manage` | Bills |
| `billing.bill` | `GET /societies/:societyId/bills/:billId` | any member<br><sub>surface: resident</sub> | One bill with its head-wise breakup and the basis of each line |
| `billing.cancelBill` | `POST /societies/:societyId/bills/:billId/cancel` | `billing.publish` | Cancel an unpaid bill (reversed in the ledger; reissue after) |
| `billing.adhocBills` | `POST /societies/:societyId/bills/adhoc` | `billing.publish`<br><sub>idempotent</sub> | Supplementary bill to one or more units (repair contribution, penalty, NOC fee…) |
| `billing.ledger` | `GET /societies/:societyId/units/:unitId/ledger` | any member<br><sub>surface: resident</sub> | Unit ledger with running balance |
| `billing.creditNote` | `POST /societies/:societyId/units/:unitId/credit-notes` | `billing.publish` | Issue a credit note (waiver or correction, reason required) |
| `billing.myDues` | `GET /societies/:societyId/my/dues` | any member<br><sub>surface: resident</sub> | Dues card for each of my units |
| `billing.myBills` | `GET /societies/:societyId/my/bills` | any member<br><sub>surface: resident</sub> | My bills, newest first |

## Realtime events

Pushed over Socket.io at `/realtime`; each refetches the reads it names. See [../server/REALTIME.md](../server/REALTIME.md).

| Event | Invalidates |
|---|---|
| `session.revoked` | `me.sessions` |
| `account.suspended` | `me.get` |
